question: How do the powers act to uproot long-entrenched worldly states?
premises: The powers are conditioned to uproot states long rooted in world and time.
From their own expansion they emit radiance.
Each power emits its own mass of rays.
inference: The powers uproot entrenched worldly conditions by radiating their own distinct expansions.
plain_english: Conditioned to uproot states long rooted in world and time, the powers, from their own expansion, send forth each its own mass of rays.
